comment: The QI migration file names, each stamped with its real creation time (UTC, YYYYMMDDHHMMSS) when the ship-phase generator first wrote it, and never renamed. The course migration carries all three capstones. The apply script orders the files explicitly: the course row first, the deep seeds, the go-live last. held_deep names the tiers whose deep seed is not written yet even if their banks are committed (the lead releases a tier once its banks are final and audited); gen_seeds.sh reports them HELD.
